description: Lists ZeroWidth's published Distributed Cognition essays (newest first): title, slug, excerpt, byline, public URL. Use this when the user asks what's been published, or when a workspace question might already have an essay behind it — then fetch the full text with `get_post`. No authentication required.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior call's nextCursor.

limit.description: Max essays to return. Defaults to 10.

name: list_posts
title: List Distributed Cognition essays
